title: Using the ladder without wasting the battery
target: How to get up to something in R.E.P.O. with the extending ladder, given that using it costs battery and it has to be placed against something real.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: Something solid at the far end

steps.do: Check the far end before extending, not after.
steps.because: the ladder has collision checks and an end collider of its own (collisionCheck)

steps.do: Extend it against something solid rather than into open air.
steps.because: it extends a bridge rather than resting on a wall (plasmaBridgePivot)

steps.do: Retract it when you are done.
steps.because: extended and unextended are states it can be put back from (extendSound)

steps.do: Spend the battery deliberately, since extending is what drains it.
steps.because: extension drains the battery at its own rate (extensionBatteryDrain)

steps.do: Leave it where it will hold rather than on a smooth surface.
steps.because: the ladder has sticky material settings of its own (littleStickyMaterial)

commonMistakes: Extending into nothing and losing the extension.
Leaving it extended for the rest of the run.
Setting out with a flat battery.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
